function.name: workspace.read
function.description: Read a file from the workspace root directory. Path is relative to workspace root, e.g. "calc.py" not "workspace/calc.py".

function.name: workspace.write
function.description: Write or overwrite a file in the workspace. Path is relative to workspace root. Creates parent directories if needed.

function.name: workspace.list
function.description: List files and directories in the workspace. Pass "." to list the root.

path.description: Directory path relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.run
function.description: Execute a script or binary. For .py files runs with python3, for .sh runs with bash. Path is relative to workspace root.

path.description: Path to script/binary relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.search
function.description: Search file contents with grep-like pattern matching.

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.compile
function.description: Syntax check or compile source code. Supports go, python, c, cpp, rust. Auto-detects language from file extension.

path.description: Source file path relative to workspace root

function.name: workspace.webfetch
function.description: Fetch a URL and return its text content as markdown.

function.name: workspace.websearch
function.description: Search the web for a query. Returns results with titles, URLs, and snippets.

function.name: wiki.lookup
function.description: Look up tool documentation from the wiki.

function.name: workspace.git_clone
function.description: Clone a git repository. Path is a subdirectory within the workspace root.

path.description: Subdirectory within workspace to clone into (e.g. "repos/project")

function.name: workspace.delete
function.description: Delete a file or empty directory. Use recursive:true for non-empty directories.

function.name: workspace.subagent
function.description: Spawn a worker subagent to perform a task. Worker runs independently using a smaller model and returns a summary. Use for searching, cloning, building, testing — anything multi-step that would consume context window.

prompt.description: Task for the subagent to perform
